title: I2C Receive
text: Configure inter-integrated circuit (I2C) module to receive data from I2C bus, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Data type} sets Type of data in data vector; {Module}, {Addressing format} sets the address format for communication 7–Bit, {Peripheral address source}, {Peripheral address register}, {Bit count}, {Read data length} sets the length of received data, {Initial output} sets the value of I2C node output to model, {Set NACK bit} sets the nACK bit during I2C acknowledge cycle, {Enable stop condition} sets the stop message to I2C Transmit block, {Output receiving status} Indicates when I2C Receive block receives and {Sample time} sets the frequency at which data is read from I2C. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: RD
ports.summary: Received data from I2C bus scalar | vector

params.name: Addressing format
params.values: Address format for communication 7–Bit addressing (default) | 10–Bit addressing | Free data format

params.name: Peripheral address source
params.values: Peripheral address source of I2C peripheral Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Bit count
params.values: Bit count for communication 8 (default) | integer in [1 8]

params.name: Initial output
params.values: Value of I2C node output to model 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Set NACK bit
params.values: NACK bit during I2C acknowledge cycle off (default) | on

params.name: Enable stop condition
params.values: Stop message to I2C Transmit block off (default) | on

params.name: Output receiving status
params.values: Indicates when I2C Receive block receives message off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which data is read from I2C device 0.001 (default) | –1 | scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Type of data in data vector int8 (default) | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32
